mapper.select: select d.id,d.period,d.biz_line,d.problem,d.decision_content,d.owner_id,d.due_date,d.related_goal_id,d.related_task_id, d.decision_status,d.version,d.del_flag,d.create_time from lab_management_decision d where d.del_flag='0' and d.decision_status='OPEN' and d.period=#{period} order by d.due_date,d.id limit 201

select t.id,'NEW_BLOCK' type,t.title,b.block_status status,t.plan_date due_date,t.period, b.block_reason definition,b.block_start_time last_updated from lab_task_block_event b join lab_task t on t.id=b.task_id and t.del_flag='0' where b.del_flag='0' and b.block_status='OPEN' and b.block_start_time>=#{since} order by b.block_start_time desc,b.id limit 201

select t.id,'FORECAST_DELAY' type,t.title,t.execution_status status,t.plan_date due_date,t.period, coalesce(t.fail_reason,t.next_action,t.result_desc) definition,coalesce(t.update_time,t.create_time) last_updated from lab_task t where t.del_flag='0' and t.task_level='week' and t.period_lock_flag='0' and t.execution_status='ACTIVE' and t.plan_date<=date_add(date(#{asOf}),interval 7 day) and (t.current_block_flag='1' or t.plan_date<date(#{asOf}) or t.result_status='DELAYED') order by t.plan_date,t.id limit 201

select t.id,'PENDING_ACCEPTANCE' type,t.title,t.workflow_status status,t.plan_date due_date,t.period, t.deliverable definition,coalesce(t.update_time,t.create_time) last_updated from lab_task t where t.del_flag='0' and t.task_level='month' and t.workflow_status='PENDING_REVIEW' and t.period_lock_flag='0' order by t.plan_date,t.id limit 201

select t.id,'STALE_KEY_RESULT' type,t.title,t.workflow_status status,t.plan_date due_date,t.period, t.next_action definition,coalesce(t.update_time,t.create_time) last_updated from lab_task t where t.del_flag='0' and t.task_level='month' and t.task_type='key' and t.period_lock_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in('DRAFT','ACTIVE') and coalesce(t.update_time,t.create_time)<#{staleBefore} order by coalesce(t.update_time,t.create_time),t.id limit 201

select m.id member_id,u.nick_name member_name,m.biz_line, sum(case when t.task_level='month' then 1 else 0 end) active_task_count, sum(case when t.task_level='week' then 1 else 0 end) recent_week_task_count, sum(case when t.task_level='week' and t.execution_status='ACTIVE' and t.plan_date<date(#{asOf}) then 1 else 0 end) overdue_count, sum(case when t.current_block_flag='1' then 1 else 0 end) blocked_count, sum(case when t.coordination_required='1' then 1 else 0 end) coordination_count, #{period} period,'按月度父任务归属统计成员结果、承诺和异常' definition,max(coalesce(t.update_time,t.create_time)) last_updated from lab_member m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' left join lab_task t on t.owner_id=m.id and t.del_flag='0' and t.period_lock_flag='0' and ((t.task_level='month' and t.period=#{period}) or (t.task_level='week' and exists( select 1 from lab_task p where p.id=t.parent_id and p.task_level='month' and p.period=#{period} and p.del_flag='0'))) where m.member_status='ACTIVE' and m.del_flag='0' and m.biz_line=#{scope.bizLine} group by m.id,u.nick_name,m.biz_line order by m.biz_line,m.id limit 201

select t.id,'MONTH_RESULT' type,t.title,t.workflow_status status,t.plan_date due_date,t.period,t.deliverable definition, coalesce(t.update_time,t.create_time) last_updated from lab_task t where t.del_flag='0' and t.owner_id=#{scope.memberId} and t.task_level='month' and t.period=#{period} order by t.plan_date,t.id limit 201

select t.id,'WEEK_COMMITMENT' type,t.title,t.execution_status status,t.plan_date due_date,t.period,t.deliverable definition, coalesce(t.update_time,t.create_time) last_updated from lab_task t join lab_task p on p.id=t.parent_id and p.del_flag='0' where t.del_flag='0' and t.owner_id=#{scope.memberId} and t.task_level='week' and p.period=#{period} order by t.plan_date,t.id limit 201

select t.id,'DUE_COMMITMENT' type,t.title,t.execution_status status,t.plan_date due_date,t.period,t.deliverable definition, coalesce(t.update_time,t.create_time) last_updated from lab_task t where t.del_flag='0' and t.owner_id=#{scope.memberId} and t.task_level='week' and t.execution_status='ACTIVE' and t.period_lock_flag='0' and t.plan_date<=date_add(date(#{asOf}),interval 7 day) order by t.plan_date,t.id limit 201

select t.id,'OPEN_BLOCK' type,t.title,b.block_status status,t.plan_date due_date,t.period,b.block_reason definition, b.block_start_time last_updated from lab_task_block_event b join lab_task t on t.id=b.task_id and t.del_flag='0' where b.del_flag='0' and b.block_status='OPEN' and t.owner_id=#{scope.memberId} and t.period_lock_flag='0' order by b.block_start_time,b.id limit 201

select t.id,'MISSING_EVIDENCE' type,t.title,case when t.result_desc is null or trim(t.result_desc)='' then 'MISSING_RESULT' else 'MISSING_EVIDENCE' end status, t.plan_date due_date,t.period,t.deliverable definition,coalesce(t.update_time,t.create_time) last_updated from lab_task t where t.del_flag='0' and t.owner_id=#{scope.memberId} and t.period_lock_flag='0' and ((t.task_level='month' and t.period=#{period} and (t.workflow_status='PENDING_REVIEW' or (t.workflow_status='ACTIVE' and coalesce(t.result_status,'DOING')<>'DOING')) and (t.result_desc is null or trim(t.result_desc)='' or not exists(select 1 from lab_task_evidence e where e.task_id=t.id and e.del_flag='0'))) or (t.task_level='week' and exists(select 1 from lab_task p where p.id=t.parent_id and p.period=#{period} and p.del_flag='0') and t.execution_status in('SELF_DONE','SELF_UNDONE') and (t.result_desc is null or trim(t.result_desc)=''))) order by t.plan_date,t.id limit 201
